guide.message: Generate a PIN in Stream Deck action settings and enter it here.

portHint.message: Use the same port as Stream Deck. When connected, changing it here also updates the server.

portInvalid.message: Port must be an integer from 1024 to 65535.

portLocal.message: Only the Chrome port was saved. Match the port in your Stream Deck settings.

connected.message: Connected · Open or refresh YouTube Music.

coverMissing.message: No album art URL found on the page

coverBlocked.message: Album art host is not allowed

stale.message: The player is slow to respond. Check Chrome Memory Saver settings.

paired.message: Paired · Open or refresh a YouTube Music window.

removed.message: Unpaired from the bridge. Enter a new PIN to reconnect.

extensionDescription.message: Control YouTube Music from Elgato Stream Deck using a Chrome extension.

notPaired.message: No pairing credentials. If you reinstalled the extension, generate a new PIN in the Stream Deck action settings and pair again. Match any custom port on both sides.

subtitle.message: For YouTube Music · Stream Deck integration

unpairFailed.message: Could not unpair. Start Stream Deck, check the port and try again.

updatePlugin.message: Bridge protocols are incompatible. Update the Stream Deck plugin.

updateExtension.message: Bridge protocols are incompatible. Update the Chrome extension.

protocolInvalid.message: Invalid compatibility information. Update both components and check again.
